title: Orbit Runner - Relay Expedition
description: Deliver six energy cells through three sectors: choose a safer flight or a richer salvage field, then trade cargo for hull repairs at the docks. Dodge asteroids and catch crystals on two orbital lanes; Classic and Daily Orbit remain available. Automatically produced by LOB7 Enhancement.
controls: Space, Arrow Up/Down or tap/click: switch orbit lane
Enter or Start button: start a new round; at docks use the route buttons instead
Relay Expedition: complete three flights with at least 6 energy cells; start with 2 cells and 3 hearts
Choose Safe passage for a shorter flight and 1 arrival cell, or Salvage field for more danger and 3 arrival cells; each crystal adds 1 cell
At the two docks, spend 2 cells to repair 1 heart, up to 3; time stops while choosing
Choose Daily Orbit to survive 60 seconds, or Classic to reach 200 points; their records exclude Expedition
Daily Orbit uses the UTC date at the start of the round; restart to retry that day's course
